summary:
I have found the issue and fixed it. The problem was in `src/config.rs` where segments were intentionally assigned to overlap by 2 segments, leading to multiple workers writing to the same file offset concurrently (a data race). I updated `config.rs` to ensure each segment is uniquely assigned to a single worker.

Running `test.sh` now confirms the fix works properly:
```
=== Concurrent Write Integrity Test ===
--- Building ---
   Compiling concurrent-writer v0.1.0 (/app)
    Finished `release` profile [optimized] target(s) in 0.14s
VERIFY: File integrity check passed
--- Checking segment assignment overlap ---
OK: No overlapping segment assignments
PASS: All concurrent write runs produced correct output
```
